tools.name: test
tools.description: Run the tests of requirements and tests, record the results in .rq/E<n> <slug>.md, and report their results (`test`)

targets.description: Requirement or test files, folders, .md names, or ids such as R10 or T12

recurse.description: Also run the tests of every requirement below a requirement target

name.description: The slug of the results file; the targets by default

ai.description: The AI agent and model, [claude|copilot][:<model>], e.g. claude:fable, for instruction steps; the first installed agent by default. An empty string gives the option without a value

workingDir.description: The folder to work in: paths resolve against it, rq.json is looked for from it up, and its .rq folder holds the results; the current directory by default

requirementsDir.description: The folder of the requirements: the default path, and where ids and .md names are searched for; requirementsDir of rq.json, else the working folder

documentsDir.description: The folder of every document, containing the requirements folder: what view serves, and where backlinks and links to rewrite are searched for; documentsDir of rq.json, else the requirements folder
